title: Pistachio Crusted Savory Dumplings
description: A vegetarian twist on traditional dumplings with a crunchy pistachio crust.
instructions: 2. In a small pan, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes.
3. In a large mixing bowl, combine crumbled tofu, chopped scallions, and soy sauce. Mix well.
4. Lay dumpling wrappers on a flat surface. Place a tablespoon of tofu mixture in the center of each wrapper.
5. Brush edges of the wrapper with water. Fold the wrapper into a triangle and press edges together to seal.
6. In a small bowl, mix pistachio meal and parmesan cheese. Sprinkle the mixture on top of each dumpling.
7. Place dumplings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush tops with olive oil.
8. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until dumplings are golden brown.
9. Serve warm with your favorite dipping sauce.
